transcript.text: my oven fan keeps going after ive turned the oven off, been about 20 mins now. is it broken??

Probably not broken. Many ovens have a cooling fan that keeps running after you switch the oven off, to cool the controls and electronics. Twenty minutes can be normal; some continue for 30–60 minutes, especially after cooking at a high temperature.

What to do:
• Leave the oven door closed and don’t block its vents.
• Check that the heating function and temperature are off — the fan may still run independently.
• It should stop once the oven has cooled.

Arrange a repair / switch it off at the cooker isolator (if safe to do so) if:
• it runs for several hours or never stops once fully cool,
• the oven is still actively heating when set to off,
• there’s burning smell, smoke, unusual noise, or a tripped fuse/breaker.

If there’s smoke or a strong burning smell, turn off power at the isolator and contact an electrician/appliance engineer.
